turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hey Marcus! Happy Saturday. How is your weekend in Portland starting off?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! It's going really well so far. I started the morning on a healthy note and just whipped up a quick protein smoothie for breakfast.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a great, refreshing start. I hope Olive didn't try to steal any of it!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Haha, no, Olive was completely knocked out sleeping in her favorite sunbeam. But the breakfast gave me plenty of energy to head out to the courts and play some tennis today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, nice! It's great to hear you're getting some tennis in. How is your back holding up? Still feeling 100% recovered?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, absolutely no issues at all today. No stiffness or pain during my serves, so I'm really glad that whole back strain is completely behind me.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is such a relief. Back injuries can be so stubborn, so I'm glad you're fully back to form. Did you play a match with Grace, or meet up with a partner?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually met up with a buddy for a couple of singles sets. Grace had some errands to run. I'm definitely feeling the workout now, though!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You definitely earned a relaxing afternoon. How are things going with the science department? Are you able to fully disconnect and enjoy the summer, or is school prep creeping in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've done a tiny bit of light prep here and there, but mostly I'm trying to just enjoy the break and not think about the classroom too much yet.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move. You've got to recharge those batteries while you can. Do you have any plans for the rest of the evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nothing major. Grace and I are just planning on a quiet night in. We'll probably just unwind and watch some sitcom reruns tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like the perfect way to spend a Saturday evening after a good workout. Enjoy the easy night, Marcus!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. Catch up with you later.
